question: A piece of land that is surrounded by water on three sides is known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**peninsula**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **peninsula** is defined as a landform that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the **mainland** on one side. It extends from a larger body of land into a **sea**, **ocean**, or **lake**.
 
• Geographically, it is surrounded by water on **three sides**. This unique structure allows it to have extensive **coastlines** while maintaining a terrestrial link for trade and movement.
 
• The word is derived from the **Latin** terms **paene** (meaning almost) and **insula** (meaning island). Essentially, it behaves like an island in terms of maritime access but remains part of a continent.
 
• A prominent example is the **Indian Peninsula**, which is bordered by the **Arabian Sea** to the west, the **Bay of Bengal** to the east, and the Indian Ocean</st
